# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 1 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 1:3 — My lord — Eve's address to Adam

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "My lord" | Literal domine mi — Latin vocative |
| LOGOS | "My lord" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "My lord" | Same — all agree |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** All three agree. The Latin domine mi is Eve's consistent deferential address to Adam throughout the text. Preserved.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of All.
